about.title: Livemed Academy
about.subtitle: Division of Clinical & Continuing Medical Education
about.description: A professional medical education institute delivering U.S.-standard training, clinical observerships, and AI-powered learning to physicians and medical students worldwide.
about.missionP1: Livemed Academy was established by a team of physician educators who recognized the need for accessible, high-quality clinical training for international medical graduates and healthcare professionals worldwide.
about.missionP2: We combine cutting-edge AI technology with proven pedagogical methods to deliver professional medical education that meets the highest standards of U.S. clinical training.
about.missionP3: Our programs have served thousands of learners from over 100 countries, preparing them for successful careers in medicine through certificates, clinical training credentials, and continuing medical education.
about.whatWeOfferDesc: Professional certificates, clinical training credentials, and continuing medical education — designed to advance your medical career.
about.ourValuesDesc: The principles that guide everything we do
about.educationalStandardsDesc: Our curriculum is developed in alignment with recognized medical education standards to ensure quality and relevance for your professional development.
about.leadershipDesc: Physician educators with decades of combined experience in academic medicine and clinical training

about.readyAdvanceDesc: Join thousands of medical professionals worldwide who trust Livemed Academy for their clinical education and professional development.
